description: ADK assembly-DRC rule parameters. Consumed by the KLayout deck (klayout/drc/adk_assembly.drc) and the KiCad DRU generator (kicad/dru/generate_assembly_dru.py). Interposer adapters MAY override individual values via Ruby (drc_rules['ASM_b'] = X); an override is that technology's own rule. v0.3.0 sets ASM_b to 200 um and adds ASM_g, die edge to interposer wire-bond pad, checked only when the interposer adapter declares wire-bond pads.

rule_descriptions.ASM_b: Minimum spacing between chiplets, in micrometres. Edge-to-edge between adjacent chiplet boundary polygons.
rule_descriptions.ASM_e: Minimum chiplet area, in square micrometres. Chiplet boundary polygons below this threshold are flagged.
rule_descriptions.ASM_g: Minimum distance from a chiplet boundary to an interposer wire-bond pad, in micrometres. Euclidean, edge to edge; a pad that touches or overlaps a boundary is flagged. Pads are read from the carrier only, never from a die layout.
